newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Senegal economy grows by 5.6 percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Senegal economy grows by 5.6 percent in 1996.

text.p: Senegal's real gross domestic product grew by 5.6 percent in 1996 compared with 4.8 percent in 1995, final figures released on Wednesday by the Economy Ministry showed.
Economic analysts said 1995 growth was boosted by the construction sector.
Samba Thiam, representative of the International Monetary Fund in Senegal said GDP growth could top six percent in 1997.
"We believe that Senegal is on the right track for sustained, durable growth," Thiam said.
